# facility-icon

## Overview

This component renders a <span> with the class `search-result-icon`, followed by a normalized version of a specified field value from the result object. The normalization process replaces spaces, pipes (`|`), and ampersands (`&`) with dashes (`-`) to generate consistent, CSS-friendly class names.

If the field is not defined, the component renders a fallback element with the class search-result-icon default.

This enables developers to apply custom icons or styles based on facility or category types using standard CSS class selectors.
